findings.observed: Secondary correction/review controls retain 42px height; some disclosures are smaller. The 44x44 target remains unmet for those controls.
findings.workaround: Pointer/keyboard with supervised use; this is not physical touch acceptance.

findings.observed: Decorative Pista label competes with text already printed on the source plan.
findings.evidence: qa/calca05-decorative-reference-1440.png; historical capture re-inspected, same runtime hash, not a fresh CALCA06 run
findings.workaround: Zoom/pan and context; no promise that all source labels are readable at initial fit.

findings.observed: Very close Trace points require zoom or selecting the Seat by name.
findings.workaround: Current zoom plus Seleccionar lugar por nombre. Separate P1 applies to Planner exact-hit precision.

findings.observed: Raster disables SVG mapping with a title-only explanation, weak for touch discovery.
findings.workaround: SVG mapping is visible and available with SVG sources; current operator guidance must explain the source requirement.

findings.observed: Trace suppresses long unselected labels and exposes the selected/focused full label. Normal finalized/consumer rendering retains label/contrast clutter.
findings.workaround: Trace zoom/name selection and contextual full accessible labels; does not resolve the P1 consumer hit-target issue.

findings.observed: Additive selection retains keyboard modifiers; no new touch-only multiselect gesture is certified.
findings.evidence: certify.mjs: correction uses Shift native gestures
findings.workaround: Keyboard modifier or correct one Seat at a time.

findings.observed: assign-seats HTTP 201 differs from OpenAPI/SDK documented HTTP 200; successful body/UI remains usable.
findings.workaround: Certification fixture explicitly expects observed 201 to continue; discrepancy remains open and no API/SDK change is made.
